slug: 2024-08-19 Libya implements biometric voter verification in municipal council elections

facts.fact: Libya Review reports that the National High Electoral Commission (HNEC) launched electronic voter-identity verification in municipal council elections, initially in four municipalities (Zliten, Al-Sbiaa, Brak, Al-Abrak), with devices registering voters' biometric data when voter cards are collected.

facts.fact: HNEC Decision 253 of 2025 adopts a regulation setting up a digital registration system by SMS and an in-person system for the voter register.

The regulation defines the voter register update as checking HNEC databases against changes in the Civil Registry Authority database, and requires applicants to hold a national number in the national number system.
HNEC announced publication of voter lists for the second phase of municipal elections, with 560,896 registered as of 13 April 2025.
HNEC's notice says voters can check their registration by sending their national number by SMS to 17017, and register with national number and polling-centre number.
